_help: preferredCameras: photos taken with these cameras are shown first and marked with a star. The first is your main camera; the others are sister models with the same lens, used as back-up. Use [] to turn this off.
_flickr: Wikimedia Commons has almost no Ricoh R1s photos, but Flickr has many. Paste a free Flickr API key below to include them (get one at https://www.flickr.com/services/apps/create/ and choose Non-Commercial). Set flickrCreativeCommonsOnly to true to show only photos the photographers released under Creative Commons.
